answer: A mechanism that actually bites: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because whisper only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, opal is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any onyx approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
